实战01：个人助手Agent

前面讲了这么多理论，这一篇开始实战。从零构建一个完整的个人助手Agent，功能包括：日程管理、信息查询、任务提醒。

💡 核心观点：实战项目的价值在于把知识点串联起来。做一遍，比看十遍都有用。

1项目结构

textpersonal-assistant/
├── main.py              # 入口文件
├── agent/
│   ├── __init__.py
│   ├── core.py          # Agent核心
│   ├── memory.py        # 记忆系统
│   └── tools.py         # 工具定义
├── services/
│   ├── calendar.py      # 日历服务
│   ├── reminder.py      # 提醒服务
│   └── search.py        # 搜索服务
└── config.py           # 配置文件

2Agent核心实现

python# agent/core.py
import os
from typing import List, Dict, Any

class PersonalAssistantAgent:
    def __init__(self):
        self.memory = ConversationMemory()
        self.tools = ToolRegistry()
        self.llm = OpenAI(model="gpt-4", api_key=os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
        self._register_tools()

    def _register_tools(self):
        self.tools.register(CalendarTool())
        self.tools.register(ReminderTool())
        self.tools.register(SearchTool())

    def process(self, user_input: str) -> str:
        context = self.memory.get_context()
        available_tools = self.tools.get_tools_for_llm()

        response = self.llm.chat(
            messages=[
                {"role": "system", "content": "你是一个贴心的个人助手..."},
                {"role": "user", "content": user_input}
            ],
            tools=available_tools
        )

        self.memory.add_message("user", user_input)
        self.memory.add_message("assistant", response.content)
        return response.content

3工具实现

python# agent/tools.py
from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
from typing import Dict, Any

class BaseTool(ABC):
    @property
    abstract def name(self) -> str: pass
    @property
    abstract def description(self) -> str: pass
    @abstractmethod
    def execute(self, **kwargs) -> Any: pass

class CalendarTool(BaseTool):
    @property
    def name(self): return "calendar"
    @property
    def description(self): return "查询或添加日历事件"
    @property
    def parameters(self):
        return {
            "action": {"type": "string", "enum": ["query", "add"]},
            "date": {"type": "string"},
            "event": {"type": "string"}
        }
    def execute(self, action, date, event=None):
        if action == "query":
            return calendar_service.get_events(date)
        elif action == "add":
            return calendar_service.add_event(date, event)

💡 实战要点：模块化设计让代码清晰、工具注册机制让扩展容易、记忆系统让Agent变得"聪明"。

实战02：多Agent客服系统

第二个实战项目：构建一个多Agent客服系统。包含接待Agent、客服Agent、售后Agent，通过消息总线协作。

💡 核心观点：多Agent系统的核心是协调机制。消息总线、任务分发、结果聚合——这三件事做好，多Agent系统就跑起来了。

1系统架构

python# customer_service_system.py
class CustomerServiceSystem:
    def __init__(self):
        self.message_bus = MessageBus()
        self.orchestrator = TeamOrchestrator()

        # 初始化三个Agent
        self.reception = ReceptionAgent(self.message_bus)
        self.support = SupportAgent(self.message_bus)
        self.after_sales = AfterSalesAgent(self.message_bus)

        # 注册到编排器
        self.orchestrator.add_member(
            self.reception, AgentRole.COORDINATOR, ["reception"]
        )
        self.orchestrator.add_member(
            self.support, AgentRole.EXECUTOR, ["support"]
        )
        self.orchestrator.add_member(
            self.after_sales, AgentRole.EXECUTOR, ["after_sales"]
        )

    def handle_customer(self, message):
        ticket = self.message_bus.create_ticket(message)
        category = self.reception.classify(message)

        if category == "support":
            result = self.orchestrator.assign_task(
                {"id": ticket.id, "task": message, "capabilities": ["support"]},
                self.support_member
            )
        else:
            result = self.orchestrator.assign_task(
                {"id": ticket.id, "task": message, "capabilities": ["after_sales"]},
                self.after_sales_member
            )
        return result

2Agent实现

pythonclass ReceptionAgent:
    def __init__(self, message_bus):
        self.message_bus = message_bus
        self.llm = OpenAI(model="gpt-4")

    def classify(self, message):
        prompt = f"""将客户问题分类：

{message}

类别：support（技术支持）/ after_sales（售后）/ billing（账单）"""
        response = self.llm.generate(prompt)
        return response.strip().lower()

class SupportAgent:
    def __init__(self, message_bus):
        self.message_bus = message_bus
        self.llm = OpenAI(model="gpt-4")
        self.kb = KnowledgeBase()

    def handle(self, ticket):
        solution = self.kb.search(ticket.message)
        if not solution:
            solution = self.llm.generate(
                f"作为技术支持回答：{ticket.message}"
            )
        self.message_bus.send_response(ticket.id, solution)
        return solution

class AfterSalesAgent:
    def __init__(self, message_bus):
        self.message_bus = message_bus
        self.llm = OpenAI(model="gpt-4")

    def handle(self, ticket):
        response = self.llm.generate(
            f"作为售后客服回答：{ticket.message}"
        )
        self.message_bus.send_response(ticket.id, response)
        return response

💡 多Agent客服优势：专业分工、7x24不间断、并发处理。三个Agent各司其职，客服效率翻倍。
